papers.title: Thin-film lithium tantalate for ultraviolet integrated electro-optic modulator
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The realization of integrated, high-speed ultraviolet modulation is pivotal for the advancement of quantum information processing, portable atomic clocks, and secure solar-blind communications. While mature photonic platforms have enabled sophisticated system-level integration across the visible and infrared spectral ranges, high-speed active modulation in the ultraviolet remains largely dependent on conventional bulk-crystal technologies. Consequently, a scalable integrated solution that simultaneously combines low insertion loss and extreme compactness with high modulation efficiency has remained challenging. Here, we report an integrated UV electro-optic modulator on a thin-film lithium tantalate platform. The device has a compact lumped-electrode of 200 μ m, exhibiting a measured 3 dB electrical-to-optical-to-electrical bandwidth above 40 GHz, a high modulation efficiency V π L of 85 mV ⋅ cm, and a measured electrical-to-electrical bandwidth beyond 67 GHz. This work establishes thin-film lithium tantalate as a disruptive platform for wafer-scale compatible active UV photonics, enabling the next generation of scalable quantum and communication systems.
papers.summary_ko: 초박막 리튬탄탈레이트(LiTaO3) 박막을 이용한 자외선 집적 전기광학 변조기를 구현했다. 200 μm 길이의 집중전극 구조로 40 GHz 이상의 3dB 전기-광-전기 대역폭과 85 mV·cm의 변조 효율(VπL), 67 GHz 이상의 전기-전기 대역폭을 달성했다. 이는 양자정보처리 및 보안 통신용 UV 포토닉스를 위한 웨이퍼 스케일 집적 플랫폼으로서의 가능성을 보여준다.

papers.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox in Polycrystalline Li‐Rich Layered Cathodes via Efficient Grain Boundary Passivation
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐voltage cathodes with hybrid anion and cation redox activities, such as Li‐rich and Mn‐rich oxides, offer a pathway to higher energy density in lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs). However, those cathodes suffer from oxygen loss from both the surface and grain boundaries, especially in traditional polycrystalline cathodes with secondary‐particle morphology. Interfacial passivation is needed, yet uniform, high‐quality coating at both primary‐ and secondary‐particle levels remains challenging. Here, using a tannic acid‐assisted process, we demonstrate an in situ formed Ba M O 3− δ ( M = Ni, Co, and Mn) perovskite phase at surfaces and grain boundaries, offering effective passivation to suppress structural and electrochemical degradation. Differential electrochemical mass spectrometry (DEMS), soft X‐ray spectroscopy (SXAS) and resonant inelastic X‐ray spectroscopy (RIXS) reveal that the passivated grain boundaries effectively mitigate oxygen release, promote the retention of oxidized oxygen within the grains, and improve oxygen‐redox reversibility. The stabilization is facilitated by strong M ─O bonding at primary‐particle surfaces, improving energy‐density stability and mitigating voltage decay. The improved electrochemical performance results from the reliable coating method, which constructs sequential interfacial bonding along grain boundaries. Using earth‐abundant elements only, this process may offer high‐quality passivation for a variety of oxide cathodes used in LIBs and beyond.
papers.summary_ko: 탄닌산을 활용한 공정으로 Li-rich/Mn-rich 층상 양극의 1차 입자 표면 및 결정립계에 BaMO3-δ 페로브스카이트 상을 형성시켜 산소 손실을 억제했다. DEMS, SXAS, RIXS 분석을 통해 패시베이션된 결정립계가 산소 방출을 완화하고 산화된 산소를 입자 내에 유지시켜 음이온 레독스 가역성을 향상시킴을 확인했다. M-O 결합 강화로 전압 감소 억제 및 에너지밀도 안정성이 개선되었으며, 희귀 금속 없이도 적용 가능한 코팅법이다.

papers.title: Redirecting Bond Cleavage in Sacrificial Prelithiation via Dual‐Side Separator Engineering for Anode‐Free Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐free lithium metal batteries (AFLMBs) promise extreme gravimetric and volumetric energy densities but suffer from irreversible active lithium loss, sluggish desolvation kinetics, and dendritic proliferation. Herein, we report a catalyst‐induced bond‐cleavage redirection concept to unlock efficient sacrificial prelithiation, implemented via a dual‐side functionalized separator. On the cathode side, a 5 µm MoC 1‐x /NC‐0.3Co coating redirects Li 2 C 2 O 4 decomposition from high‐barrier Li–O cleavage to preferential C─C bond scission. Theoretical calculations and operando characterizations confirm this mechanistic shift, lowering the delithiation potential to 3.79 V at 60°C with a 99.5% Li + utilization rate. To safeguard the liberated lithium inventory against depletion, the anode side integrates a PSSLi‐PFPE bilayer. This coating accelerates Li + desolvation and drives the in‐situ construction of a LiF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase, enabling Li symmetric cells cycling for over 1700 h (1.0 mAh cm −2 , DOD = 80.7%). Bridging fundamental bond kinetics with practical engineering, the assembled 1.0 Ah anode‐free pouch cell (NCM811||MoC 1‐x /NC‐0.3Co‐LCO/PE/PSSLi‐PFPE||Cu) achieves gravimetric and volumetric energy densities of 458.6 Wh kg −1 and 1005.2 Wh L −1 , a power output of 989.1 W kg −1 , retaining 80.1% capacity after 100 cycles. This non‐invasive separator strategy provides a unified framework connecting bond kinetics to practical cell manufacturing, charting a feasible avenue for high‐energy AFLMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 리튬금속전지의 비가역적 리튬 손실 문제를 해결하기 위해 양면 기능화 분리막을 이용한 촉매 유도 결합 절단 재지향 전략을 제시했다. 양극측 MoC1-x/NC-0.3Co 코팅이 Li2C2O4 분해 경로를 C-C 결합 절단으로 전환시켜 60°C에서 3.79V의 낮은 탈리튬화 전위와 99.5%의 리튬 이용률을 달성했고, 음극측 PSSLi-PFPE 이중층이 LiF가 풍부한 SEI 형성을 촉진해 1700시간 이상의 대칭셀 사이클링을 구현했다. 1.0 Ah 무음극 파우치셀은 458.6 Wh/kg, 1005.2 Wh/L의 에너지밀도와 100사이클 후 80.1%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Nanocast sodium metasurfaces for enhanced light-matter coupling
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium has been proven to be a plasmonic material superior to noble metals. However, its high chemical reactivity poses a major obstacle to direct nanopatterning via conventional techniques, hindering the pursuit of sodium metasurfaces that simultaneously deliver high coupling efficiency and high quality factor. In this work, we developed a nanocast sodium-argon metasurface by rapidly cooling liquid sodium on a polymethyl methacrylate nanomold. This metasurface supports high-Q plasmonic resonances with record-high performance, surpassing previously reported alkali metal plasmonic systems. The liquid sodium consistently maintains an ultra-low filling depth regardless of the mold depth, which not only creates a nonlocal photonic configuration but also affords precise control over the radiative-to-dissipative loss ratio. Such casting behavior enables the metasurface to transition from under-coupling to critical-coupling regimes, thereby achieving high-efficiency, tunable second harmonic generation. We further provide direct experimental evidence that sodium outperforms silver in nonlinear optical performance. By leveraging the robustness inherent to the nonlocal nanocasting technique for sodium-argon metasurfaces, we demonstrate a large-area second harmonic generation metasurface with polarization-switchable imaging. The proposed sodium nanocasting technique opens an alternative avenue for sustainable high-performance plasmonics.
papers.summary_ko: 액체 나트륨을 PMMA 나노몰드에 급속 냉각시켜 나노주조 방식으로 소듐-아르곤 메타표면을 제작했다. 이 구조는 몰드 깊이와 무관하게 초저충전 깊이를 유지하며 고Q값 플라즈모닉 공명과 비국소 광학 거동을 구현해 기존 알칼리 금속 플라즈모닉 시스템을 능가하는 2차 고조파 발생 성능을 보였다. 소듐이 은(Ag)보다 우수한 비선형 광학 특성을 가짐을 실험적으로 입증하고, 대면적 편광 전환 이미징이 가능한 메타표면을 구현했다.

papers.title: Gradient Mg and Uniform Ti Co‐Doping Suppresses Jahn–Teller Effect in LMFP via Optimized Ion‐Transport Kinetics and Interfacial Reactions
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT LiMn 0.6 Fe 0.4 PO 4 (LMFP), an olivine‐type cathode material, is gaining attention in high‐energy‐density lithium‐ion batteries due to its high operating voltage and cost‐effectiveness. However, its practical use is limited by slow Li + diffusion, poor electronic conductivity, and structural degradation caused by Jahn–Teller distortion from Mn 3+ . To tackle these challenges, we have developed a dry‐and‐wet synthesis method to produce Mg/Ti co‐doped LMFP (Mg/Ti‐LMFP). This approach ensures uniform Ti 4+ doping at Fe sites and gradient Mg 2+ doping at Li sites. Ti 4+ strengthens the structural stability by forming M─O bonds, reducing Jahn–Teller distortion. Additionally, surface‐enriched Mg 2+ creates a protective layer, preventing manganese dissolution and electrolyte decomposition. The optimized structure and chemistry enhance Li + transport kinetics, stability, electronic conductivity, and cycling durability. Mg/Ti‐LMFP demonstrates 88.7% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 1C (25°C) and 88.2% after 100 cycles at 1C (55°C). This study lays a solid foundation for designing high‐performance co‐doped olivine‐type cathode materials, guiding the development of future energy storage solutions.
papers.summary_ko: LiMn0.6Fe0.4PO4(LMFP) 올리빈 양극재의 얀-텔러 왜곡 문제를 해결하기 위해 Fe 사이트에 균일한 Ti4+ 도핑과 Li 사이트에 구배형 Mg2+ 도핑을 적용한 건식-습식 복합 합성법을 개발했다. Ti4+가 M-O 결합을 강화해 구조 안정성을 높이고, 표면에 농축된 Mg2+가 보호층을 형성해 망간 용출과 전해질 분해를 억제했다. Mg/Ti 공동도핑 LMFP는 1C, 25°C에서 200사이클 후 88.7%, 55°C에서 100사이클 후 88.2%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Discovering Underpotentially Deposited Crystalline Sodium Metal Nanoparticles on the Surface of Hard Carbon Anodes
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium-ion batteries are attractive candidates for low-cost and scalable energy storage in which hard carbon (HC) anodes are used. However, sodium (Na) metal plating in HC anodes at voltages above the plating potential remains a critical problem. The location and spatial distribution of crystalline sodium (c-Na) metal nanoparticles, the clusters associated with Na storage in HCs, are important for understanding this underpotential plating behavior but remain unclear. Here, we implement a cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and electron tomography (cryo-ET) workflow that directly localizes c-Na metal clusters in sodiated HC samples: cryo-ET maps nanoscale three-dimensional (3D) distributions, while cryo-EM resolves local structure and chemistry. Our workflow reveals that c-Na metal clusters reside predominantly on the surfaces or near surfaces of individual HC particles. This finding challenges existing interpretations in the literature that locate the c-Na metal clusters within closed nanopores in the bulk of the HC, presumably because prior characterization using nonimaging techniques and two-dimensional (2D) projection images associated with traditional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) lacks the spatial 3D information necessary to resolve the full spatial distribution. Our discovery is an important step toward explaining the underpotential plating phenomenon of Na metal in HC anodes, suggesting that particle-level surface and near-surface interfaces are relevant targets to mitigate plating alongside bulk-pore, electrode, and electrolyte/interphase design.
papers.summary_ko: 극저온 전자현미경(cryo-EM)과 전자토모그래피(cryo-ET)를 결합해 나트륨이온전지 하드카본 음극 내 결정질 소듐 금속 나노입자의 3차원 분포를 직접 관찰했다. 결과적으로 c-Na 금속 클러스터는 하드카본 입자 내부의 폐쇄 기공이 아니라 입자 표면 및 근방에 주로 위치함을 밝혀, 기존 통념을 뒤집는 발견을 제시했다. 이는 하드카본 음극에서의 언더포텐셜 소듐 금속 도금 현상을 이해하는 데 중요한 단서를 제공한다.

papers.title: Bifunctional Additive Enabled Thermoresponsive Electrolytes With Dual‐Mode Manipulation Toward Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Thermal safety issues arising from electrolyte instability at elevated temperatures pose a critical challenge for lithium (Li) metal batteries (LMBs). Thermoresponsive electrolytes offer a promising solution, yet battery systems with high‐rate capability and reliable thermal protection have not been realized. Herein, we introduce a bifunctional LiNO 3 additive into a high‐volume‐fraction vinylene carbonate‐based thermoresponsive electrolyte (HVCE‐N) to enhance the performance of LMBs at room and elevated temperatures. Notably, the introduction of the LiNO 3 additive modifies the solvation structure of Li + and forms a Li 3 N/LiN x O y solid electrolyte interface with high ionic conductivity. Under thermal shock, HVCE‐N undergoes a rapid liquid‐to‐solid phase transition upon free radical polymerization to form a polymer network. More importantly, LiNO 3 can regulate the free radical concentration to control the degree of polymerization, thereby preserving high ion transport capability even after phase transition. As a result, a Li||NCM811 cell based on HVCE‐N exhibits high‐rate performance from 1C to 10C, and stable cycling at 100°C. When subjected to a thermal shock of 200°C, HVCE‐N suppresses thermal runaway for Li||NCM811 pouch cell. This electrolyte design offers a new strategy to develop highly safe LMBs with high‐rate performance.
papers.summary_ko: 전압응답형 전해질에 이중기능 LiNO3 첨가제를 도입해 상온 및 고온에서 리튬금속전지 성능을 향상시켰다. LiNO3는 Li+ 용매화 구조를 조절해 Li3N/LiNxOy 계면을 형성하고, 열충격 시 라디칼 중합을 통한 액체-고체 전이의 중합도를 제어해 상전이 후에도 높은 이온전달능력을 유지시킨다. Li||NCM811 셀은 1C~10C의 고율 성능과 100°C에서의 안정적 사이클링을 보였으며 200°C 열충격에서도 열폭주를 억제했다.

papers.title: Time‐Domain Regulation of Electrolyte Microenvironments Enables 30 mA cm − 2 Stable Lithium Plating/Stripping for High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The practical application of high‐voltage lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is severely hindered by interfacial instability and structural degradation, fundamentally originating from “time‐domain mismatch” between rapid parasitic reactions and sluggish interface passivation. Herein, we propose a time‐domain responsive in situ gel polymer electrolyte (SiNCO‐GPE) to dynamically regulate the electrolyte microenvironment. The (trimethylsilyl)isocyanate (SiNCO) acts as a “scavenging cage” to eliminate trace water and hydrogen fluoride, while its reaction products subsequently participate in interfacial evolution. The in situ polymerized poly(vinylene carbonate) integrated with poly(vinylidene fluoride‐co‐hexafluoropropylene) electrospun fiber skeleton creates a F‐O co‐coordination environment to facilitate fast Li + transport. The electroactive isocyanate group in SiNCO, together with lithium difluoro(oxalato)borate and fluoroethylene carbonate, decomposes preferentially to rapidly construct a robust B/N/F‐rich interphase layer during initial cycling on both the anode and cathode, while the Si‐containing scavenging products are dynamically incorporated into the interphase layers during prolonged cycling to accommodate mechanical stress. The SiNCO‐GPE enables exceptional Li plating/stripping stability for over 4000 h at 1 mA cm − 2 and withstands an ultrahigh current density of 30 mA cm − 2 over 70 h, while the Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 cell delivers an outstanding capacity retention of 90.5% after 500 cycles at 4.7 V, offering new insights into the development of durable high‐voltage LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압 리튬금속전지의 시간영역 불일치 문제를 해결하기 위해 전해질 미세환경을 동적으로 조절하는 시간응답형 젤 고분자 전해질(SiNCO-GPE)을 제안했다. SiNCO가 수분과 HF를 포집하는 스캐빈저 역할을 하며 반응 생성물이 B/N/F가 풍부한 계면층 형성에 참여해 양극과 음극 모두에서 안정적인 계면을 구축한다. 이 전해질은 1 mA/cm²에서 4000시간 이상, 30 mA/cm²의 초고전류밀도에서도 70시간의 리튬 플레이팅/스트리핑 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Lattice‐Level Negative Thermal Expansion Enables Thermomechanical Self‐Compensation in High‐Rate Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Localized Joule heating in high‐rate lithium metal batteries often induces severe thermomechanical failure of polymer separators and accelerates thermal runaway in cells with Ni‐rich NCM cathode. Here we report a multiscale separator design strategy that translates lattice‐level negative thermal expansion into macroscopic thermomechanical self‐compensation. In this design, Cu 2 P 2 O 7 is coupled with the PVDF‐HFP matrix through a PDA mediated interface. Temperature‐dependent structural analysis and thermal‐response tests demonstrate the anisotropic lattice contraction of Cu 2 P 2 O 7 , which relieves the thermally induced deformation of PVDF‐HFP through PDA mediated interfacial interactions. The amine‐rich PDA layer further suppresses corrosive hydrofluoric acid during the cycling, improving interfacial durability. The resulting composite membrane maintains complete dimensional stability up to 200°C while preserving high ionic conductivity and a uniform Li + flux. As a result, Li||Li symmetric cells with the self‐compensating separator operate for more than 3000 h at 1 mA cm −2 . When paired with Ni‐rich NCM811 cathodes, full cells maintain 1000 stable cycles at 5 C and deliver 135 mAh g −1 at 60°C after 100 cycles. This work demonstrates a solid‐state negative thermal expansion strategy for active separator protection, providing a materials route for mitigating thermomechanical failure in high‐power lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬금속전지의 국부적 줄열로 인한 분리막 열역학적 파손을 해결하기 위해 격자 수준의 음열팽창 특성을 활용한 다중스케일 분리막 설계를 제시했다. PDA를 매개로 Cu2P2O7을 PVDF-HFP 매트릭스에 결합시켜 비등방성 격자 수축이 PVDF-HFP의 열변형을 상쇄하도록 했으며, 아민이 풍부한 PDA층이 불산 부식을 억제해 계면 내구성을 높였다. 이 분리막은 200°C까지 치수 안정성을 유지했고, Li||Li 대칭셀은 3000시간 이상, Ni-rich NCM811 완전셀은 5C에서 1000사이클 안정적으로 작동했다.

papers.title: Dual‐Axial Nitrogen Coordination‐Induced Mn Charge Localization at Fe‐Mn Dual‐Atom Sites for Enhanced Sulfur Redox Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The optimization of coordination environments for heteronuclear dual‐atom catalysts (DACs) has been a formidable challenge in lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) batteries, arising from complex electronic coupling induced by inherent inter‐metallic‐site charge transfer at heteronuclear sites. Herein, an Fe‐Mn dual‐atom catalyst (FeMn‐(N ax ) 2 DAC/NC) with dual‐axial nitrogen coordination anchored on nitrogen‐doped carbon is rationally constructed to achieve the directional electronic modulation of active sites. The axial nitrogen ligand reconfigures the electronic distribution of Fe‐Mn heteronuclear sites, inducing Fe‐to‐Mn charge transfer and further charge localization on the Mn center. The electronic effect precisely modulates Mn d‐orbital energy levels, reinforcing the d‐p orbital hybridization between active sites and lithium polysulfides (LiPSs). The FeMn‐(N ax ) 2 DAC/NC strengthens the chemical adsorption of LiPSs to suppress the shuttle effect, and further bidirectionally accelerates the rate‐determining steps of sulfur redox: the solid‑to‑solid conversion from Li 2 S 2 to Li 2 S and the oxidative dissociation of Li 2 S. Consequently, the resultant sulfur cathodes deliver a discharge capacity of 682 mAh g − 1 at 5 C and an ultralow capacity decay rate of 0.047% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 3 C. This work offers a novel strategy for optimizing the redox kinetics of sulfur cathodes in Li‐S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: Fe-Mn 이원자 촉매(FeMn-(Nax)2 DAC/NC)에 이축 질소 배위 구조를 도입해 리튬-황 전지의 황 레독스 반응 속도를 향상시켰다. 축방향 질소 리간드가 Fe-Mn 이종원자 사이트 간 전하 이동을 유도해 Mn 중심에 전하가 국소화되고, 이는 Mn d-오비탈 에너지를 조절해 활성 사이트와 리튬 폴리설파이드 간의 d-p 오비탈 혼성화를 강화한다. 이를 통해 다황화리튬의 셔틀 효과를 억제하고 Li2S2에서 Li2S로의 고상 전환을 가속화해, 황 양극은 5C에서 682 mAh/g의 방전용량과 3C, 1000사이클에서 0.047%/사이클의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Battery Electrode Engineering Enables Fast Charging LMFP Cells Without Carbon‐Coated Foil
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium manganese iron phosphate (LiMn x Fe 1‐x PO 4 , LMFP) has emerged as a promising Li‐ion battery cathode material due to its high voltage, thermal stability, and cycle life, yet its intrinsically low electronic and ionic conductivity limits high‐rate performance and thus usefulness in fast‐charge applications such as electric vehicles. Here, we evaluate key electrode design aspects, investigating the interplay between calendering density and current collector priming (carbon‐coating) on the fast cycling performance of LMFP cathodes. For electrodes on pristine aluminium, calendering to high density induced particle embedment into the foil (quantified via segmentation of cross‐sectional microscope images), reducing interfacial resistance while enhancing both rate capability and long‐term cycling stability. In contrast, performance of electrodes on C‐coated aluminium exhibited minimal sensitivity to densification. Surprisingly, at sufficiently high calendering pressure (achieving density ≥ 2.5 g cm −3 ), the carbon coating provided no advantage to high‐rate performance, in stark contrast with conventional understanding, and cells manufactured with pristine Al achieved fast charging from 10% to 80% SOC in just over 15 min, a key milestone for this chemistry. These findings establish a mechanistic understanding of how density and interfacial properties govern transport and electrochemical behavior in LMFP cells, providing practical guidance for optimized electrode structures.
papers.summary_ko: LiMnxFe1-xPO4(LMFP) 양극의 고율 성능을 개선하기 위해 칼렌더링 밀도와 집전체 탄소코팅 간의 상호작용을 분석했다. 순수 알루미늄 집전체에서 고밀도 칼렌더링을 적용하면 입자가 포일에 박히며 계면저항이 낮아지고 고율 성능과 장기 사이클 안정성이 향상되는 반면, 탄소코팅 알루미늄은 밀도 변화에 둔감했다. 특히 밀도가 2.5 g/cm³ 이상일 때 탄소코팅의 이점이 사라지며, 순수 알루미늄 전극으로 10%에서 80% SOC까지 15분 이내의 급속충전을 달성했다.

papers.title: Sulfone cosolvent design to enable hydrogen-bond regulated alcohol-based electrolyte with high F- transference number for reversible fluoride ion batteries

papers.title: Toward Practical Zn‐Ion Batteries Through Separator/Electrolyte Co‐Design
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT While substantial research effort has been paid to address short‐circuits and parasitic hydrogen evolution reactions (HER) in Zn‐ion batteries (ZIBs), a remaining challenge that is often overlooked is ZIB separators. Currently, thick glass fiber (GF) separators are used, which unnecessarily reduce the volumetric cell performance and lead to non‐uniform Zn plating/stripping. Unfortunately, separators optimized for Li‐ion batteries are intrinsically hydrophobic and therefore incompatible with aqueous ZIB systems. Here, we propose using a hybrid organic‐aqueous electrolyte which is compatible with thin polypropylene (PP) separators developed for Li‐ion batteries. The hybrid electrolyte, together with the PP separator, enables uniform Zn plating and suppresses HER. Combined, these effects allow for stable cycling for 4360 h at 1 mA cm −2 and 3 mAh cm −2 in a Zn symmetrical cell. Further, replacing the currently used 350 µm‐thick GF separator with our proposed 23 µm PP separator can increase the energy densities of multi‐layer pouch cells by over 2.5‐fold. Finally, Zn//NVO full cells using our hybrid electrolyte and separator demonstrate stable cycling performance for over 200 cycles at a high areal capacity of 4.4 mAh cm −2 , demonstrating that electrolyte/separator co‐design is an overlooked strategy toward practical ZIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 아연이온전지(ZIB)에서 그동안 간과되었던 분리막 문제를 전해질과 분리막의 공동 설계로 해결한 연구이다. 유기-수계 혼합 전해질을 리튬이온전지용 얇은 폴리프로필렌(PP) 분리막과 조합해 균일한 Zn 도금을 구현하고 수소발생반응을 억제했으며, 기존 350µm 유리섬유 분리막을 23µm PP 분리막으로 대체해 파우치셀 에너지밀도를 2.5배 이상 높였다.

papers.title: Ion‐Electron Convergent Interphases Enable Ultrahigh Sulfur Utilization for All‐Solid‐State Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state batteries offer a safer route toward electrochemical energy storage with high energy density, but the active‐material utilization is commonly limited by unbalanced carrier transport dynamics through spatially decoupled delivery pathways, which overlap only at restricted reaction fronts. Such an issue is particularly severe for electronically and ionically insulating sulfur/Li 2 S, making efficient sulfur conversion the key bottleneck for practical all‐solid‐state lithium–sulfur batteries (ASSLSBs). Here, we propose surface‐bound ion‐electron convergent interphases on the Li 2 S surface that reconstruct localized triple‐phase contacts into an integrated active surface. Using the effective magnetic moment, originating from spin asymmetry, as a screening criterion for interfacial affinity, Li 2 FeS 2 is identified to form a robust surface‐bound interphase with Li 2 S, which bridges separated ion and electron pathways at the reaction areas, decreasing the transport tortuosity and lowering the activation barriers for both Li 2 S oxidation and reduction. Consequently, ASSLSBs stably work over 10 000 cycles at 1 mg cm −2 while delivering a loading‐insensitive sulfur utilization of 97.8% and 95.8% at 1 and 8 mg cm −2 , respectively. Moreover, a record areal capacity of 38.69 mAh cm −2 is achieved, highlighting the spatially surface‐bound mixed conductors as an effective design principle for synchronizing coupled ion‐electron transfer (CIET) in all‐solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬-황 전지에서 전기적/이온적으로 절연성인 황/Li2S의 활물질 활용률이 삼상 접촉 불균형으로 제한되는 문제를, Li2S 표면에 이온-전자 융합 계면을 형성해 해결했다. 스핀 비대칭에서 유래한 유효 자기모멘트를 계면 친화도 스크리닝 기준으로 사용해 Li2FeS2가 Li2S와 견고한 표면 결합 계면을 형성함을 확인했으며, 이 계면이 이온/전자 경로를 연결해 수송 굴곡도와 활성화 장벽을 낮춘다. 결과적으로 1 mg cm-2에서 10000사이클 이상 안정 구동하며 1/8 mg cm-2에서 각각 97.8%/95.8%의 황 활용률과 38.69 mAh cm-2의 면적용량을 달성했다.

papers.title: From Localized Electrochemical Behavior to Interfacial Reaction Mechanisms: Evaluation of Corrosion Inhibitors for Active Pb-Containing Phases in Sanxingdui Embrittled Gold Masks
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The Sanxingdui gold masks are Au–Ag–Pb ternary alloys in which preferential corrosion of intergranular active Pb-containing phases causes severe embrittlement and threatens long-term preservation. Here, corrosion inhibitors for these vulnerable microdomains were evaluated by integrating microstructural characterization, scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM), and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Sodium cysteinate (NaCys), sodium hexametaphosphate (SHMP), sodium silicate (NaSi), and sodium salts of saturated fatty acids (NaCn, C6–C18) were screened on simulated Au–Ag–Pb alloys. NaCys and SHMP induced pronounced Pb depletion, while NaSi formed a hydrophilic, cracked deposit with limited protection. In contrast, NaCn showed a pronounced but non-monotonic carbon-chain-length dependence. NaC9, NaC10, and NaC12 exhibited the best overall performance, with NaC10 providing the highest and most stable localized inhibition. Shorter chains produced less ordered and less hydrophobic films, whereas longer chains were limited by poor effective solubility and interfacial accessibility. DFT calculations showed that inhibition cannot be predicted from adsorption strength alone. By combining adsorption energy, Pb defect formation energy, and interfacial retention energy, we established an interfacial reaction criterion distinguishing stable film formation from inhibitor-induced Pb extraction, thereby introducing the concept of effective inhibitor interfacial reactivity for mechanism-guided conservation. This approach provides a targeted strategy for protecting Sanxingdui gold masks and other complex multiphase metallic heritage objects.
papers.summary_ko: 싼싱두이(三星堆) 금 가면의 Au-Ag-Pb 합금에서 취화를 유발하는 Pb 상의 부식을 억제하는 보존용 부식 억제제를 평가한 문화유산 보존 연구로, 배터리 소재와는 무관하다.

papers.title: Entropy Stabilized Li‐Rich Layered Oxide Nanoparticles for Advanced High‐Voltage Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The performance enhancement of emerging flexible batteries relies on the development of advanced small‐particle electrode materials. However, current cathode materials with reduced particle size mostly suffer from low operating voltage, especially aqueous based electrodes. In this study, by using laser‐induced carbothermal method, we successfully fabricated high‐entropy doped Li‐rich nanoparticles as layered oxide cathodes that exhibit outstanding high‐voltage performances. The direct bottom–up nanocrystal growth enables the formation of such exclusive Li‐rich nanoparticles with unprecedentedly small diameter of 83.08 nm. As confirmed by atomic‐resolution imaging, operando x‐ray diffraction and synchrotron techniques analysis, the cathode achieves high lattice stability at elevated cut‐off voltage through the combined effects of heteroatomic composition and reduced particle diameters. Molecular dynamics simulations using machine‐learning interatomic potentials further demonstrate suppressed oxygen loss and stabilized transition‐metal framework in the high‐entropy doped cathodes. Consequently, the cathode operates steadily at voltage window of 2.5–4.8 V with ultrahigh power density of 877.9 Wh kg −1 at 1 C. The assembled full cell and fiber battery provide significant practical feasibility during high‐voltage cycling. This work provides an efficient strategy for designing high‐voltage flexible batteries, offering critical insights for next‐generation energy storage research.
papers.summary_ko: 유연 전지용 고전압 양극으로서 레이저 유도 카보열(carbothermal) 방법을 통해 고엔트로피 도핑된 리튬리치 나노입자(직경 83.08nm)를 합성했다. 원자분해 이미징과 operando XRD, 싱크로트론 분석으로 이종원소 조성과 입자 미세화가 결합되어 고전압 컷오프에서 높은 격자 안정성을 달성함을 확인했으며, 머신러닝 포텐셜 분자동역학 시뮬레이션은 산소 손실 억제와 전이금속 프레임워크 안정화를 보여준다. 이 양극은 2.5-4.8V 전압 범위에서 1C에 877.9 Wh kg-1의 출력밀도로 안정적으로 구동했다.

papers.title: Closed‐Pore Engineering Couples Sodium Confinement and Interfacial Stabilization for Dendrite‐Resistant Hard Carbon Anodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Hard carbon, a leading anode for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), suffers from nonuniform sodium deposition, which causes dendrite growth and compromises safety and cycle life. Here, we report a closed‐pore engineering strategy based on cobalt‐doped hard carbon (CoHC) that couples internal sodium‐cluster confinement with interfacial stabilization. Internally, the closed nanopores redirect sodium storage from surface accumulation to deep pore filling, thereby inhibiting the growth of quasi‐metallic sodium clusters and dendrite propagation. Externally, the closed‐pore architecture regulates interfacial chemistry, leading to a thin, uniform, inorganic‐rich solid–electrolyte interphase (SEI) with reduced charge‐transfer resistance. In situ electrochemical tests confirm stable interfaces and suppressed dendrite growth in both Na||CoHC half cells and CoHC||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 (NVP) full cells, whereas severe dendritic deposition occurs on pristine hard carbon (HC) under identical current density. The CoHC anode delivers superior cycling stability with a capacity retention of 95% after 500 cycles, significantly outperforming HC. This work paves the way for dendrite‐resistant, safer, and longer‐lasting sodium‐ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지 하드카본 음극의 불균일한 소듐 증착으로 인한 덴드라이트 성장 문제를, 코발트 도핑 하드카본(CoHC)의 폐쇄기공 엔지니어링으로 내부 소듐 클러스터 가둠과 계면 안정화를 결합해 해결했다. 폐쇄형 나노기공이 소듐 저장을 표면 축적 대신 깊은 기공 충전으로 전환해 준금속성 소듐 클러스터 성장을 억제하고, 얇고 균일한 무기물 풍부 SEI를 형성해 전하전달 저항을 낮춘다. CoHC 음극은 기존 하드카본 대비 500사이클 후 95%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.
